Gary: That sounds good, Ethan. I really could use some help organizing my schedule to make time for myself too.

- Belief: Gary’s overwork is not just professional obligation; something more personal or hidden is involved.

- Belief: Now understands the real pressures Gary faces and sees that Gary is overwhelmed but willing to change.  
- Desire: To relieve Gary’s burden and help him build a sustainable work-life balance.

- Expectation: Believes Gary can improve with structured help and shared problem-solving.

- Preference: Prefers staying involved and available while Gary builds healthier habits.
